member.name: T:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.Shell.App
member.summary: Application entry point and composition root for the Window/Level Reset demo host. Wires up the DICOM model, status notifier, undo service, and fallback defaults, then constructs the ViewModel and shows the main window.
member.remarks:
Supported launch arguments:
--simulator --seed=demo — loads a CT series with DICOM defaults WW 1500 / WC -600 (preset "Lung").
--no-dicom-ww — loads a series without DICOM windowing tags so Reset applies the fallback (WW 400 / WC 40).

member.name: T:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.Shell.DispatcherStatusNotifier
member.summary: WPF status-bar notifier that displays a transient message and auto-dismisses it using a on the UI thread. Implements so the status-bar text can data-bind to and update live.
member.remarks: This is the WPF-specific realisation of envisaged by ADR-001 (§Decision item 4). The tested class library ships a WPF-free variant; the demo host uses this dispatcher-based one so no cross-thread marshalling is required when the timer clears the text.

member.name: T:Philips.CT.Host.ImageDisplay.Shell.WindowCenterToBrushConverter
member.summary: Converts a DICOM Window Center (HU) value into a grayscale so the demo viewport visibly changes brightness when the Window/Level is reset. This is a presentation-only helper; it carries no clinical meaning beyond making the reset visible during the demonstration.
